name: MClean Technologies Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有公布任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售公告，业务线维持精密清洗与表面处理、无尘室包装与组装、塑料注塑与模具三项。年内主要企业活动为免费发行凭单、拟回购最多10%自身股份以及进行中的重大诉讼，均不涉及业务模式变化。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments; its business lines remain precision cleaning and surface treatment, cleanroom packaging and assembly, and plastic injection moulding and tooling.
